title: Travelsoft says its Orchestra travel booking platform was hit by a cyberattack
date_note: TourMaG's article of 20 November quotes Travelsoft's president saying the attack began 'cette nuit' (last night); the page gives no clock time.
geo_basis: country of the affected agencies and networks named by TourMaG (Leclerc Voyages, Havas Voyages, Selectour, Carrefour Voyages)
summary: Travelsoft's president Christian Sabbagh told TourMaG on 20 November that its Orchestra travel software had been the victim of a cyberattack since the night before and that its systems were protected as a precaution. TourMaG reported that many travel agencies and tour operators could not make bookings and that sites such as Leclerc Voyages, Havas Voyages and Carrefour Voyages were offline. How much data was taken was not known, TourMaG said.
plain: A software platform many travel agencies use to book holidays was shut down after a cyberattack, its owner Travelsoft said, and many agencies could not make bookings.
exec: A shared booking platform's shutdown after a cyberattack halted bookings across many travel agencies and tour operators at once.
action: As TourMaG urges, Orchestra users should be very vigilant about emails and phone messages in the coming days, check who is contacting them and follow Orchestra's instructions.

key_findings: Travelsoft's president says Orchestra has been the victim of a cyberattack since the night before and systems were protected as a precaution
Many agencies and tour operators could not book; several agency networks' sites were offline
recommendations: Be very vigilant about emails and messages in the coming days and follow Orchestra's instructions

validation.note: One publisher read: TourMaG, quoting Travelsoft's president Christian Sabbagh. L'Echo touristique reports the platforms are operational again but answered 403; no Travelsoft notice read. TourMaG's report that customers were told to change passwords is 'selon nos informations' and is left out.

review.note: Compared title, date, Sabbagh cyberattack statement, offline sites, data-unknown line and TourMaG vigilance advice (attributed) against TourMaG; single_source correct
